prefix_policy: GSM8K reference-answer teacher forcing on both teacher and student; all target tokens supervised. Blocks of32 with detached recurrent caches (TBPTT). Equal example weight; no online rollouts.

caveats: Supervised Reader objective, reference prefixes and GSM coverage change together; not a one-factor ablation.
KL weight0.1 is a preregistered initial setting, not a validation-selected optimum.

MCQ uses candidate-normalized probabilities; GSM uses full-vocabulary probabilities. Loss scales need not be numerically comparable across tasks.
MMLU-Pro is the existing custom split; historical test subsets have been inspected.
Native body prefill remains part of Full-Sync; no prefill-free latency claim.
